name: Crossovers
concept: Mashups of two other families, each a joke that has to work as a daily chat client: the visual grammar of one system rendered with the materials of another. Stage is always 'crossover'; implementation reuses the parent families' fonts, icons and enhancer pieces instead of bundling its own. x-win311-lcars (Win 3.1 windows in LCARS colours), x-teams-sketch (Teams 2026 anatomy as a Balsamiq wireframe), x-kde-e16 (Breeze Dark widgets in E16 brushed-metal frames).

sources.title: Dossier: research/03-styles-platform.md §1 Teams, §2 Windows 3.11, §3 KDE Breeze, §4 LCARS
Microsoft KB 102976 — Windows colour schemes (Win 3.x values)

limits: Depends on the parent families' assets and enhancer modules; the build flattens assets to <family>--<file>, so cross-family references need either build support or copies.
Iframes (Element Call, widgets) stay light/dark; only their frames get the mashup chrome.
LCARS is © CBS/Paramount and Teams/Windows are Microsoft trademarks — fine for this internal project, not for public shipping.
Hashed CSS-module classes (event tiles, room list, badges) need substring selectors; the Teams card layout and the LCARS frame both restructure with CSS grid only, no DOM moves.
Bitmap-style fonts (W95FA) only look right at 16px multiples; body size is therefore fixed at 16px in x-win311-lcars.

variants.name: Crossover · Starfleet runs Windows 3.11
variants.tagline: Program Manager on the bridge: Win 3.1 windows, title bars and ▼▲ buttons, rendered in LCARS colours on black.

fonts.ui: W95FA (from win311 assets, OFL) 16px → Pixelated MS Sans Serif
fonts.display: Antonio (from lcars assets, OFL), ALL CAPS, right-aligned
fonts.mono: PxPlus IBM VGA 8x16 (from win311 assets, CC BY-SA 4.0)

shape.radius: elbow outer 64px / inner 32px on the frame; 2px (Win 3.1 corner-pixel knock-out) on buttons; 0 on windows

variants.texture: none (flat LCARS colour blocks; optional 2×2 dither on inactive title bars)
variants.motion: Win 3.1 wireframe 'zoom rectangle' when dialogs open (120ms, outline only), LCARS button press = brightness 1.15; opt-in synthesised two-tone chirp; all off under reduced motion
signature: flat Win 3.1 title bars in atomic tangerine #FF9900 (active) / blue-bell #9999CC (inactive) with centered bold black caps
control-menu 'bar' box at the left and ▼ ▲ triangle buttons at the right — still no ✕, on a starship
the whole app inside one LCARS frame: left block stack = Program Manager groups (spaces), top/bottom elbows
push buttons are lilac pills with a 1px black outline and Win 3.1 2px bevel (#FFE6FF / #996699)
menu bar under the room header: ROOM  EDIT  VIEW  CALL  HELP with underlined mnemonics, numbers like 47-1138 everywhere

regions.shell: black field inside a single LCARS frame (left vertical arm + top and bottom elbows, segmented bars with black 6px gaps); Element content sits in a Win 3.1 MDI workspace
regions.spaces: LCARS block stack as Program Manager group icons: each space = coloured block, black right-aligned caps label + number (01-HOME); active = #FF9900
regions.roomlist: MDI child window 'ROOMS' with a Win 3.1 title bar; rows are list-box lines in W95FA, selected inverted (#FF9900 bg, black text), unread as '(3)' after the name
regions.header: the room's MDI title bar: flat #FF9900, centered bold caps '#ROOM — DECK 7', control-menu box left, ▼▲ right; menu bar below with call buttons as menu items
regions.timeline: black client area, IRC-style '<ALICE> hello', sender in LCARS colour per user (decorative tokens → 8 LCARS colours), timestamps as [stardate] numerals
regions.names-avatars: square avatars with a 2px palette border, posterised (16-colour filter from win311); names in Antonio caps
regions.composer: bottom elbow bar holding a Win 3.1 single-line edit (black slot, #FFCC99 text, 1px #9999CC outline) + a default push button 'TRANSMIT' with thick outline
regions.rightpanel: second MDI child window ('MEMBERS', 'THREADS') with title bar and bevel frame inside the LCARS frame
regions.buttons: lilac/blue-bell/tanoi pills, black Antonio caps label bottom-right, 1px black outline + 2px bevel; pressed shifts 1px; default = 2px outline
regions.inputs: Win 3.1 flat edit: black field, 1px #9999CC outline, #FFCC99 text, block caret #FF9900
regions.dialogs: Win 3.1 modal (double frame, title bar with control-menu box only) coloured LCARS; buttons ACKNOWLEDGE / CANCEL as pills, destructive = #CC6666
regions.menus: Win 3.1 drop-down: black with 1px #9999CC border, no shadow, selection inverted #FF9900; tooltips as small tanoi blocks
regions.settings: settings dialog = Control Panel window: tabs as a vertical LCARS block stack, panes as Win 3.1 group boxes
regions.auth: full LCARS frame with 'LCARS ACCESS 40274 — LOG ON' Win 3.1 dialog in the middle
regions.scrollbars: Win 3.1 17px scrollbar recoloured: 1px black outline, track #333 (dithered), fixed-size square thumb in #9999CC, triangle arrow buttons
regions.focus: Win 3.1 dotted rectangle in #FFCC99 around the label PLUS a 2px solid #FFCC99 outline (offset 2px) so it stays ≥3:1
regions.badges: black numerals on a small #FF9900 block at the left end of the row; mentions = #CC6666 block
regions.code: PxPlus IBM VGA on black, 12px blue-bell left bar, LCARS-tinted hljs (keywords #FF9900, strings #99CCFF, comments #9999CC)
regions.iframes: calls/widgets run dark; framed as an MDI child window with title bar
regions.icons: Compound icons hidden in primary chrome and replaced by Antonio caps labels (LCARS has no icons); kept (recoloured) inside menus for recognition
regions.motion: zoom rectangle on dialog open, brightness on press, optional chirp; no data-cascade animation in the timeline

variants.enhancer: none in phase B: the LCARS frame, title bars, menu bar and TRANSMIT label are pure CSS (pseudo-elements + @win311/@lcars assets); opt-in chirps postponed

variants.name: Crossover · Teams, sketched by the PM
variants.tagline: Microsoft Teams 2026 as the Balsamiq wireframe the product manager drew on a Friday — with a purple marker.

fonts.display: Balsamiq Sans Bold (headings), Architects Daughter for sticky-note annotations (from sketch assets, OFL)
fonts.mono: Comic Shanns Mono (from sketch assets, MIT)

variants.texture: plain wireframe paper; hatching (repeating-linear-gradient −41°) for selected rows and placeholders
variants.motion: none at rest; hover = 1px wobble translate on buttons (once, 120ms); off under reduced motion
signature: the Teams 2026 anatomy — 68px app bar with icon+label, chat list, header with Chat | Shared | + tabs, message cards — but every box is a 2px hand-drawn #222 stroke
Teams purple #654CF5 used only like a PM's marker: selection pill on the app bar, scribbled tab underline, primary buttons, own-message tint #E8E8FF
own messages as right-aligned cards, others as white cards on grey — drawn, not rendered
hatched selected rows and Balsamiq 'X box' image placeholders while media loads
yellow sticky-note annotations in empty states ('v2: presence dots?', 'TODO ask legal')

regions.shell: grey #F2F2F2 'canvas' behind white wireframe panels, each panel outlined with a 2px irregular stroke, Teams top bar sketched with a search box
regions.spaces: Teams app bar: 68px column, icon + Balsamiq label under it (Activity/Chat/Teams…), selected = purple marker pill on the left edge + hatched tile
regions.roomlist: Teams chat list: avatar circle, name, preview, time; selected row = hatching + 2px stroke; unread = bold + hand-drawn purple circle around the count
regions.header: Teams chat header: avatar, name, tabs Chat | Shared | + with scribbled purple underline on the active tab, call buttons as sketched pill
regions.timeline: Teams cards: others white cards with irregular stroke on the grey canvas, own right-aligned on #E8E8FF; bubble layout forced visually even in modern layout
regions.names-avatars: names in Balsamiq Sans bold #222, avatars grayscale inside a wobbly pencil circle, presence dot as a hand-drawn ring
regions.composer: Teams rounded compose box drawn with 2px stroke, formatting toolbar as sketched icons, purple send arrow
regions.rightpanel: white panel with irregular stroke; member list as Teams roster (sketched)
regions.buttons: primary = purple fill with #222 hand-drawn stroke and white label; secondary = white with stroke; hover wobble 1px
regions.inputs: irregular 2px stroke, focus = purple stroke + focus ring
regions.dialogs: Teams dialog as a wireframe sheet, irregular stroke, flat offset shadow, slight −0.4° tilt
regions.menus: white sheet with 2px stroke, hover = hatching
regions.settings: Teams-like settings list in wireframe, toggles drawn as pill outlines with purple knob when on
regions.auth: login drawn as a Balsamiq mockup screen with a sticky note 'use SSO here'
regions.scrollbars: 8px, thumb = #222 outline pill with white fill
regions.focus: 2px solid #654CF5 outline offset 2px plus the element's own stroke turning purple
regions.badges: count inside a hand-drawn circle (irregular radius) in purple, mentions in critical red
regions.code: graph-paper background, JetBrains Mono, monochrome hljs with purple keywords
regions.iframes: light; framed with a sketched window stroke
regions.icons: Compound icons kept but thickened (stroke via drop-shadow) and #222; optional Balsamiq-like replacements later
regions.motion: only the hover wobble; no boiling filters

variants.enhancer: none in phase B: app-bar labels, header tabs and sticky notes are CSS pseudo-elements

variants.name: Crossover · Breeze in brushed metal
variants.tagline: Plasma 6 Breeze Dark widgets inside 1999 E16 BrushedMetal-Tigert window frames.

fonts.display: Silkscreen (from enlightenment assets, OFL) caps on metal title bars

shape.shadow: Breeze 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25) on menus; metal frames use 1px #3B3F44 outline + inset highlight

variants.texture: brushed-metal (horizontal streaks, CSS repeating gradients over #B4B8BC → #8E9398) on frames only
variants.motion: Breeze 150ms ease on hover outlines; E16 'window shade' roll-up of dialogs on close (100ms); off under reduced motion
signature: horizontally brushed grey metal title bars (#D9DCDE → #B4B8BC → #9EA3A8) with black Silkscreen caption and 1px emboss
chunky 14px bevelled E16 window-button trio on dialogs and the room header (decorative, aria-hidden)
Breeze Dark content: View #141618 timeline, Window #202326 room list, radius 5 widgets
Plasma blue #3DAEE9 focus = 1px outline + 3px translucent glow, hover outlines turn blue
space panel as an E16 iconbox/pager strip in metal, room list in Breeze

regions.shell: Breeze Dark Window colour app background, metal frame around the whole app (4px brushed border with 1px #3B3F44 outline)
regions.spaces: E16 iconbox: vertical brushed-metal strip, space avatars in recessed dark wells, active well with blue glow
regions.roomlist: Breeze Dark Window #202326 list, NeoChat rows (32px avatar, name, accent unread pill), selected = accent 25% fill + accent outline, radius 5
regions.header: brushed-metal title bar: room name in black Noto Sans bold centered with emboss, E16 bevel button trio right, Breeze flat tool buttons (black icons on metal)
regions.timeline: Breeze View #141618, flat NeoChat compact messages, optional radius-5 bubbles in #1D1F22, own tinted #1E5774
regions.names-avatars: round Breeze avatars, Breeze-friendly username colours (decorative tokens → Breeze palette), Noto Sans 600 names
regions.composer: brushed-metal shelf frame (E16 dock look) holding a Breeze Dark line edit (radius 5, blue focus border + glow) and a send tool button
regions.rightpanel: Breeze Dark card panel with a thin metal title bar strip per card
regions.buttons: Breeze buttons: #292C30 fill, 1px outline, hover outline #3DAEE9, default = accent outline; inside metal bars they become E16 bevel buttons
regions.inputs: Breeze line edit: #141618, 1px #3B3F44, radius 5, focus accent border + glow
regions.dialogs: Breeze Dark dialog body with a brushed-metal title bar, Silkscreen caption, E16 button trio; KDE button order (Help left, OK/Cancel right)
regions.menus: Breeze menus (#1D1F22, radius 5, soft shadow), selected item accent 25% + outline; tooltips Breeze
regions.settings: settings dialog with metal title bar; tab list as Kirigami sidebar in Breeze Dark
regions.auth: a single E16 metal window on a dark gradient desktop, Breeze form inside
regions.scrollbars: Breeze thin pill (8 → 14px on hover) recoloured as metal #8E9398 with bevel
regions.focus: 1px #3DAEE9 outline + 0 0 0 3px rgba(61,174,233,.3) glow; on metal backgrounds an additional 2px #141618 inner ring for ≥3:1
regions.badges: Breeze accent pill #3DAEE9 with #141618 text; mentions #BF3343 fill (Breeze negative darkened for 4.5:1) with white text

regions.iframes: dark; framed by a metal title bar
regions.icons: Compound icons recoloured: light on Breeze surfaces, black on metal; optional Breeze icon swap via the kde family
